shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, and a Combat Extended bridge. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553 (window-3 build); window-4 prep now STALE AGAIN - two post-prep fixes landed (save/load transit death, start-spot edge ladder), both built and unverified.

Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. 101 .cs files, ~30,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: BUILD MODE, POST-PREP FIXES LANDED.** `build_mod` green. **⚠ WINDOW-4 PREP STALE, TREE DIRTY:** post-`1c51484` changes now are §29c (save/load transit), §29d (start-spot ladder), ABSkySync false-comment fix, **and the §15b guard health panel (+6 keyed strings, 92→98)**. When publish resumes: commit+push → backup → Release LAST → strip, all redone. **Workshop 3776015553 is still on the WINDOW-3 build.**

**⚠⚠ WINDOW 4 HAS BEEN FULLY PREPPED AND RESTORED TWICE WITHOUT SHIPPING.** The blocker was never mechanics (§31b + never-run subsystems + now four unverified changes). **The prep is not the bottleneck.**

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FOUR RULES THIS PROJECT PAID THE MOST FOR:**
1. **NOTHING COSMETIC ON DECIDING PATHS** (§33c); **CLAMP AT SELECTION** (§35).
2. **NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`** - use `RegionsRoomsChanged` (§34e) - **AND REPLAY THE ACCIDENTAL WORK WHEN YOU DO (§29c)**.
3. **REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER** (§34b): flood CELLS.
4. **COUNT THE EMITTERS AND THE POPULATIONS - AND THE ENGINE STACKS** (§44).

**⚠ NEXT-SESSION QUEUE, in order:** (1) verify §29c (save → reload → cross-level job, nothing built in between) + §15b panel (trip a guard via a stress action, check tick goes red, re-arm) in ONE launch; (2) §43 + §44 CE verification launches; (3) commit, redo prep, §31b answers, upload; (4) §13.

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, `(w, 1, bandCount*Slot)`; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)*64`; 64-alignment load-bearing.
**The one insight:** `Region.Neighbors` is topological; Portal wormholes conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temp/vacuum; the jobified pathfinder cannot cross a synthetic link → segmented movement.
**⚠⚠ `CanReach` = "with stairs"; pathfinder = "walking now"** (§34, §40).
**⚠⚠ SYNTHETIC LINKS ARE WIPED BY EVERY REGION REBUILD AND ARMED ONLY BY OUR HOOK (§29c):** any rebuild path without a hook firing after it = the whole mod silently off. Known instance: load (fixed). Open audit: §13.17.
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK GENERALISES TO NEITHER UTILITIES NOR COMBAT (§41i).**
**⚠ THE GUTTER:** shells (§41f), radial searches (§41i), skyfaller offsets (§41b), spanning shoot lines (§41k), CE round collision (§44), start-spot scatter (§29d).
**⚠ THE VIEW IS DOWNWARD-ONLY; physics, combat rendering, sound and traffic are symmetric.**
**⚠⚠ ANISOTROPY BREAKS EVERY RAW DISTANCE TEST.** `BandOf` CLAMPS.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, ten shapes — anchor/field/noise/extent/aspect/scalar/foreign-writes/radius-vs-gutter/list-sweep/raw-participant-maths. `ABBandLocal.cs` canonical. Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — 126/128 (7 cap) · **190/192 (4)** · 254/256 (2); 200 is the number to avoid; plan persists between colonies.

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA — segmented at `StartPath`; hops strictly decrease; multi-hop ✅. TWO CARRY TRIGGERS (§33c/h). **ONE DESCENT RULE + ONE SANCTIONED SIBLING (`ABShaft.ColumnOpen`).**

# 8b. DEPTH SHRINK — loose contents only; terrain never; no shrink for flecks/relayed things.

# 9. GENERATION COST — FillRock tracks HILLINESS; RAINFALL dominates Plants. **⚠⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES TEST VALIDITY. ⚠ SWAMPY FLAT TILES ARE THE START-SPOT STRESS CASE (§29d).** *(Runs 407/409 reference: Tundra/Flat/swamp 0.28, 5 bands of 126.)*

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST. ⚠ Palette strips its LAST entry (pad it). ⚠ OUR REPORTS = warning rows.**
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE; NEITHER IS A ONE-POPULATION PASS; NEITHER IS A LAUNCH THE HUMAN DID NOT REPORT BACK ON.**
**⚠⚠ BUILD THE DETECTOR WHEN READING WON'T YIELD. ⚠⚠ A DIAGNOSTIC THAT CAN SILENCE ITSELF IS A TRAP. ⚠⚠ AN INSTRUMENT CAN BE FOOLED BY THE TERM IT HUNTS. ⚠⚠ SILENT FALLBACK BRANCHES MUST LOG THEIR CENSUS (§29d).**
**⚠ CIRCINUS: python, not jq.**

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove innocence by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. One change per experiment. Diagnostic before theory; after five failed theories, SHIP THE INSTRUMENT.
**⚠⚠ COUNT EMITTERS/HOMES/POPULATIONS/DERIVATIONS/SENSES/DIRECTIONS/ENGINE STACKS - AND GAME LIFECYCLES (§29c).**
**⚠⚠ AN EVENT SUBSCRIPTION ONLY SEES CHANGES AFTER IT EXISTS (§29c):** replay the polling version's accidental work (initial arm via `LongEventHandler.ExecuteWhenFinished`; `Map.FinalizeInit` rebuilds regions BEFORE components' FinalizeInit; shared handler body so paths cannot drift).
**⚠⚠ AN API BUILT FOR A UI IS NOT THE UI (§15b):** ABGuard's readout surface (AllSwitches/LastContext/LastCulprit/ReArm) shipped with ZERO consumers for weeks while its comments described the panel as existing. When adding a data half "for the settings panel", wire the panel IN THE SAME COMMIT or write TODO, not prose that claims it is done. Grep consumers before trusting any comment's claim that a surface is used - or unused (RoofSync, same day, opposite direction).
**⚠⚠ SUPPRESSING A DRAW IS SAFE; SUPPRESSING A BAKE IS NOT (§29b). ⚠⚠ A SKIPPED `Regenerate` IS STILL MARKED CLEAN (§29b). ⚠⚠ A MUTABLE GLOBAL IN A SKIP CONDITION IS A PROMISE TO DIRTY ON EVERY TRANSITION (§29b). ⚠⚠ MECHANICAL PREP IS NOT PROGRESS WHEN THE BLOCKER IS EDITORIAL. ⚠⚠ A REMAP CAN NEUTRALIZE YOUR OWN DOWNSTREAM HOOK (§44). ⚠⚠ FALLBACKS THAT DECIDE SILENTLY GET DIAGNOSED BACKWARDS (§29d): ladder beats cliff; log the failed rung's census.**
**⚠⚠ SURFACE-ONLY-BY-ACCIDENT IS NOT A RULE (§43). ⚠⚠ SECOND ENTRY POINTS, NOT FACTION CHECKS (§41i). ⚠⚠ HELPERS REIMPLEMENTING RANGE/BEARING/ANCHOR MATHS ARE INVISIBLE TO VERB PATCHES. ⚠⚠ "DECLINE TO HELP" IS NOT "DENY" (§41c). ⚠⚠ MOVEMENT SYMPTOMS CAN BE RANGE CHECKS. ⚠⚠ THE MISS PATHS ARE A SECOND FEATURE. ⚠⚠ ONE-PAWN-TYPE REPORTS AREN'T TYPE-SPECIFIC. ⚠⚠ DERIVED ANSWERS CAN'T BEAT SOURCES. ⚠⚠ BLIND INSTRUMENTS. ⚠⚠ TELEPORT EXITS RE-DISPATCH. ⚠⚠ thingIDNumber STATICS. ⚠⚠ ONE GESTURE, THREE PATHS. ⚠⚠ REVERT-FIRST. ⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT'S ALREADY BUILT (§29d margin; §15b API half).**
**⚠ THE USER'S EYE BEATS THE AGENT'S ARITHMETIC - A PLAYER'S CODE REVIEW BEATS BOTH - A PLAYER'S SAVE FILE BEATS ALL THREE. ⚠ VERIFY "FALSE POSITIVES" AGAINST THE SOURCE. ⚠ INVESTIGATE COUNT DISCREPANCIES. ⚠ FALSE COMMENTS OUTLIVE THEIR TRUTH WINDOW - n=2 IN ONE DAY, BOTH DIRECTIONS (RoofSync "unused" while live; ABGuard panel "exists" while unbuilt). ⚠ FLAVOR NEVER BREAKS AN INCIDENT. ⚠ PARTICIPATION BY ALLOWLIST. ⚠ A SHADOW CAN BE DRAWN WHERE NOBODY LOOKS. ⚠ HONESTY RULES CAN BE REPLACED BY MORE HONEST RULES. ⚠ EXACT-MATCH KEYS ON SCATTERED VALUES MISS ON EVERY MISS. ⚠ FOUR CASES, ONE DEFECT. ⚠ IMPOSSIBLE FEATURES MAY BE FREE. ⚠ GUARDS ARE PER-CONSUMER. ⚠ COUNT CONSUMERS. ⚠ A ROUNDING-ERROR OPTIMISATION IS NOT WORTH A CORRECTNESS HAZARD. ⚠ FUNNEL BRANCHES LIE UNEQUALLY. ⚠ COPY GOES STALE; NEVER UPDATE AHEAD OF VERIFICATION NOR AHEAD OF THE SHIPPED BUILD (§31c). ⚠ RECORD FALSE POSITIVES. ⚠ DOCUMENTED ROUNDING ERRORS CAN BEAT FRAGILE FIXES.** *(One-liner archive unchanged.)*
**Patching.** Wrap DATA; patch PRODUCERS; INNER METHODS over wrappers; no foreign types in patch signatures; prefix releases in FINALIZERS; `[ThreadStatic]` latches; RE-ENTER WITH CORRECTED INPUTS; REIMPLEMENT WHEN GUARDS SIT AHEAD; POSTFIX-CORRECT COSMETICS; BOX/SETVALUE/UNBOX structs; REBUILD IMMUTABLE-ANCHOR STRUCTS; gate LIFETIME or OBSERVER; SUPPRESS AT `Visible`, NEVER AT `Regenerate`; EVENT SUBSCRIPTIONS NEED AN INITIAL REPLAY.
**Engine facts.** *(archive unchanged.)* `Map.FinalizeInit` order: RebuildAllRegionsAndRooms → components LAST. Radial searches return the cell NEAREST THE SEED. `Widgets.CheckboxDraw` = read-only tick visual, no font risk.
